name: What Comes Around...
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 4,200 experience instead of 2,000, 2.1 times as much. New rewards: Ursine Hammer. Read from what the game server sent in the beta. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Targorr the Dread served under Gath'Ilzogg as supreme Executioner.  His methods were ruthless, even by filthy orc standards.  Men who fought bravely to defend the Kingdom were tortured on his whim.  Now he is being held in the Stormwind Stockade, sentenced to die.  Yet something is amiss.  One of the bureaucratic nobles put a hold on his execution.  I am sure foul play is in the works.

Put an end to Targorr the Dread, adventurer.  Travel to The Stockade and behead him before trickery is upon us.
narrative.objectives: Bring the head of Targorr the Dread to Guard Berton in Lakeshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: Targorr the Dread has finally met his fate. I for one am glad to hear the beast now knows what it is like to be on the receiving end of Death's ruthless grip. You have done well, adventurer. Sometimes the truest justice can only be found outside the courtroom and beyond the clouded vision of politics.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you been to Stormwind yet, to The Stockade? I fear whatever trickery that has kept Targorr the Dread alive for this long will eventually bring about his freedom. He was sentenced to die, adventurer, not act as some political pawn on a noble's whim.
